declarations.docstring: The algebra equivalence between the symmetric algebra on a product module and the tensor product of the two symmetric algebras.
The product-to-tensor algebra equivalence sends a generator from the first factor to its left tensor inclusion.
The product-to-tensor algebra equivalence sends a generator from the second factor to its right tensor inclusion.
The algebra homomorphism from the symmetric algebra on a product module to the tensor product of the symmetric algebras of its factors.
The algebra homomorphism from a tensor product of symmetric algebras to the symmetric algebra on the product module.
